node_definition.done_when: Read section 32 of crew-observability-truth first. The crew ack docstring and its --run help in reckon/cli.py say that a promoted run is accepted as well as a live one. recorded_promoted_acknowledgements in reckon/crew/runs.py removes an acknowledgement file whose until has passed when it reads one, and keeps honouring a current one exactly as today. tests/test_expired_acknowledgement_is_swept.py works in a temporary config home. It writes one expired and one current acknowledgement file, reads obligations, and asserts that the expired file is gone and the current one is honoured. It also asserts that the ack help text names a promoted run. The removal case fails at your base. Existing tests reaching crew ack and the acknowledgement readers keep passing; grep tests/ for crew ack, record_run_acknowledgement, recorded_promoted_acknowledgements and acknowledgements to build the gate. Record the outcome in docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/expired-acknowledgement-is-swept.html. Run `date -u` first and treat that instant as your start; your deadline is 60 minutes later. Write your manifest before starting any long command. Run both gate arms with pytest-xdist (-n 8 --timeout=300), never serially. Run the base arm, from a `git archive` extraction of your base under /tmp in a directory named for this run, and then the head arm, each in the foreground: a background command dies when your turn ends. Keep the gate to the test files that reach your change, tens of files rather than hundreds. Each arm uses its own basetemp outside any repository and writes to its own new log path, which it never overwrites. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder. Each log names its revision on the first line as revision= followed by the full sha, and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed Python paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
